The tool accepts only one corrects_jrnl_no and one status change per correction. I'll submit a correction for finding F001 that handles a single duplicate pair. It voids invoice 801 and reverses journal 2472 only.

Invoice 801 duplicates invoice 510, which is paid and was entered first, so 801 is the copy to void. Journal 2472 is DR 5200 981.43 / CR 2000 981.43, so the reversal is DR 2000 981.43 / CR 5200 981.43. I post it in period 11, which is open.

This leaves the 802/348 duplicate (journal 2473) uncorrected. The tool's single-journal, single-status-change convention doesn't allow fixing both pairs in one call.
